item.body:
### Summary
In Favoris, and only there so far, the first scroll stutters. That is the scroll that hides the large title and minimises the Liquid Glass tab bar. Once both are done, scrolling is smooth.

### Feedback (operator, 2026-11-17, device, point G)
Reported after #998, the large titles. The operator asked whether this should be a separate issue, an input to the performance and consistency review, or a study first. cloud/orch's choice: **one issue, labelled for the end-of-M4 performance review (#774)**. The cause needs a measurement before any fix.

### Leads, not established
- Only Favoris shows it. Its list is sectioned, with collapsible sections, and its rows are heavier (#962). The other main pages are plain lists.
- Two animations run together: the large title collapses (`.largeThenPill`, #998), and the tab bar minimises (`Réduire la tab bar au scroll`, `minimizesTabBarOnScroll`).
- A scroll-geometry observer may run on every frame (`onScrollGeometryChange`, #898 `PagerVisibility`, the title-pill switch) and re-render the whole list.

### Scope
1. **Measure on the Mac**: an Instruments trace (SwiftUI and Hitches) of the first scroll in Favoris, against Catégories. Find which view bodies re-evaluate per frame.
2. Fix the cause in its own PR. Never hide it: no disabling the minimise, no removing the large title.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A trace that names the hitch's cause.
- [ ] After the fix, no hitch over 1 frame (iPhone, 120 Hz) on the first scroll of Favoris, measured.

### Related
#774 (end-of-M4 performance review), #998, #962, #898.

comments.body:
**Operator observations (2026-11-17, device, relayed by cloud/orch):**
1. The same stutter happens **in the other direction**: back at the top, while the large title comes back and the Liquid Glass tab bar expands.
2. It **scales with the number of visible rows**. It is less marked with Favoris categories collapsed, and smooth with only « Discussions » (41 favourites).

**Reading (cloud/orch, not measured):** the cost grows with the row count, and it only shows during the two bar transitions. So something that changes on every frame of those animations (scroll geometry, safe-area or content-margin insets, the title display state) probably invalidates the whole Favoris list. The rows' bodies are then re-evaluated per frame, where only the bars should animate. The other main pages have fewer or lighter rows (#962 made the Favoris rows heavier), which would explain why only Favoris shows it.

**What to check:**
- the Instruments SwiftUI trace (« View Body » counts per frame during the collapse and the expand), Favoris against Catégories;
- any `@State` or observable value updated from `onScrollGeometryChange` or safe-area readers, and read high in the Favoris view tree (#898 `PagerVisibility`, the #998 title mode, a `GeometryReader` in the section headers);
- whether the rows are `Equatable` or isolated from that state.

Fix: keep per-frame state out of the rows' dependency path, rather than slowing or disabling the bar animations.

comments.body:
**cloud/orch: code study (read-only, origin/dev-swift `bb084956`), to be confirmed with Instruments**

Short version: no state written on *every frame* was found. What was found is **one invalidation of the whole Favoris `List` per crossing**. It fires exactly when the large title leaves or comes back, which is also when the tab bar minimises or expands. Its cost is O(sections + rows), which fits the operator's report (smooth with one category of 41 rows, stutters with many sections).

**Ranked suspects:**
1. **`titleIsVisible` lives in `TopicListView`** (`TopicListView.swift:30`). It is written by `ScreenTitle.swift:91` (`onScrollVisibilityChange`) and read at `:39-41` and `:58`.
   - Each crossing re-runs all of `TopicListView.body`: `model.displayedGroups` is recomputed twice (`TopicListModel.swift:144-161`, `FavoritesPresentation.groups`), the sectioned `ForEach` is diffed, and every realised row gets new swipe, context-menu and accessibility closures (`:145-176`), as does every header (`:234-263`). `canCollapseMore` also walks every favourite (`RootTabsView.swift:116-133`).
   - Catégories and Messages use the same pattern, but their flat rows are cheap.
   - **Fix:** move the visibility into a small `@Observable` tracker that `TopicListView.body` never reads, and let a `PillSlot` view inside the principal toolbar item read it.
2. **Rows and headers are not `Equatable` and carry closures**, so every `TopicListView` update re-applies every visible cell's modifiers.
   - **Fix:** a `FavoriteRowCell: Equatable` and a `FavoriteSectionHeader` built from values (`.equatable()`), and `displayedGroups` stored or memoised.
3. **No `.listStyle` on `TopicListView`** (Catégories and Messages use `.insetGrouped`). In the Favoris split sidebar it may resolve to the sidebar style, with pinned headers relaid out under the bars. Unproven; try `.listStyle(.insetGrouped)`.
4. **`DensityHeaderMargin`** (`ListDensity.swift:132-143`): one `onGeometryChange` per section header, wasted in regular density. Skip it when `rowSideInset == nil`, or use list insets instead of a measurement.
5. **`PagerBarModifier`** writes `@State` on bottom-inset changes, even with no pager (`PagerToolbar.swift:194, 228-244`). This amplifies but is not specific to Favoris. Make it a no-op when `pager == nil`, and do not observe `hiddenInset`.
6. Minor: `TopicRowInfoLine.swift:40-44` builds a `Calendar` on each body run (use a `static let`).

**To measure on the Mac (mac/M1):**
- `Self._printChanges()` in `TopicListView.body`, `PagerBarModifier.body` and `DensityHeaderMargin.body`: once per crossing confirms 1 + 2, repeated runs mean a flip-flop.
- The Instruments SwiftUI template (View Body, Cause & Effect) plus Hitches.
- A/B tests: (a) `.insetGrouped` alone, (b) the title-state move alone, (c) Equatable rows. Expectation: (b) + (c) remove the scaling with sections.

Note: #1012 (cloud/i1012-sonnet) is reworking `ScreenTitle` for the missing pill; suspect 1's fix belongs in the same code and has been passed on to it.
